optimizedDescription.value: Workspace names specs, code, schemas, ownership, context, and graph identity; all specs resolve through one qualified workspace view.

optimizedContext.value:
# Workspace

## Rules
- Unique config name follows `/^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$/`. `default` mandatory local workspace; `root` reserved graph namespace. Reject whole-name Windows devices `con|prn|aux|nul|com1…com9|lpt1…lpt9` case-insensitively on every OS; `con-foo` legal.
- Properties: required `specs`; non-default-required `codeRoot` (default workspace uses project root); optional `schemas` (default workspace defaults `specd/schemas`); `ownership` default owned for default/readOnly otherwise; optional `prefix`, `contextIncludeSpecs`, `contextExcludeSpecs`. Relative paths resolve from `specd.yaml`.
- `isExternal` inferred when resolved specs path lies outside project repository; never declared.
- Ownership `owned|shared|readOnly`. Shared writes like owned. ReadOnly permits reads/context/dependencies but rejects change scope add, archive, `SpecRepository.save()`, and `saveMetadata()` with `ReadOnlyWorkspaceError`.
- ReadOnly errors identify blocked operation and ownership reason; never suggest configuration remediation.
- `prefix` prepends capability paths, supports multiple segments, need not be unique; invalid syntax → `ConfigValidationError`.
- IDs are `workspace:capabilityPath`; bare input means `default:path`; unknown workspace rejected; internal form always qualified.
- Active workspaces derive at runtime from `change.specIds` through `parseSpecId()`/`workspaces` getter; never persisted. Empty IDs → empty workspaces. Primary workspace is first derived entry, used for `{{change.workspace}}` and default archive attribution.
- Cross-workspace use cases receive `ReadonlyMap<string, RepositoryInstance>`, one repository per configured workspace.
- Workspace context patterns apply only when active. Bare pattern qualifier means current workspace; `*` means all current-workspace specs. Apply after project patterns. Excludes never remove transitively reached `dependsOn` specs.
- Cross-workspace spec refs use qualified IDs; schema refs use `#workspace:name`. Unknown workspace: config validation error; runtime context warning+skip.
- Change paths always include workspace: `specs/<workspace>/<capability-path>/<artifact-filename>`, `deltas/<workspace>/<capability-path>/<artifact-filename>.delta.yaml`.
- Consuming project `specd.yaml` is sole workspace source. Never read external repository config.

## Constraints
- Every project declares `default`; non-default requires `codeRoot`.
- Workspace name excludes reserved names and Windows devices.
- `isExternal` inferred; internal spec IDs fully qualified.
- Change workspaces derive only from `specIds`.
- ReadOnly blocks all write paths without remediation advice.
- External configuration never imported.
